scope: First practical transfer check of the frozen twelve-class baseline on an existing real32kS/s channel. No fitting, frequency-shift sweep, resampling, DC removal, model selection or synthetic data generation.
reference: Existing recorded438.8MHz channel with user-reported audible FM speech is the intended first input. Expected label is a recording-level listening reference, not verified truth of each128ms block. Never call matching proportion test accuracy.
input: Existing channel-analysis folder with CHANNEL_COMPLETE, channel_report.json, channel.cf32. Require nominal32000S/s, little-endian complex64, complete sample count/file length. Skip existing statistic_start_sample transient, then nonoverlapping4096-sample blocks in original order; report omitted tail. No frequency correction or additional channel filtering.
model: Exactly saved classical35-feature5NN baseline and train-only scaler. Verify complete source report/registered plan/code/model hashes and original feature/scaler/model consistency using existing freeze_source. CPU/NumPy inference, all twelve classes. Block RMS0.5 only; no thresholds tuned on recording.
quality: Zero-power/nonfinite blocks get explicit invalid status and no class vote. Do not silently drop from totals. Valid blocks get forced known-class5NN output; no unknown-signal capability or calibrated probability is claimed. Neighbor vote counts are integers0..5, not confidence percentages.
outputs: Fresh models/classical-real-channel-TIMESTAMP: protocol, per-block timestamp/RMS/class/votes CSV, full summary and file hashes. Expected-reference match count and proportion explicitly descriptive. Source channel, metadata and classifier hashes checked unchanged at end.
decision: This is a practical go/no-go observation for further real-data work, no automatic deployment or general modulation accuracy claim. A match on one FM recording does not validate other classes; failure means do not build a live recognizer on this model yet. No post-hoc corrective shift or class removal.
limits: Adjacent blocks share recording and are dependent. Listening reference not per-block labels. Real32kS/s narrow-channel signal distribution may differ from synthetic generator. No false-alarm/unknown-signal evidence, no Coral or drone protocol proof. No additional transmitting hardware operation.
